seats.label: Plan
seats.outcome: Picks the account, pillar, format and day part for the day. Skips holidays and days already filled; one post per account per day.

seats.label: Source check
seats.outcome: Seeds the next unused atom, then opens a fresh source for any statistic. A number with no opened source is dropped.

seats.label: Script
seats.outcome: Writes the hook, beats, kinetic words, call-outs and caption in the host's voice. Claims stay inside what GTM OS does on screen.

seats.label: Produce
seats.outcome: Talking head take, then Remotion: fast cuts, kinetic captions, call-out cards, live screen captures, a stat card and an end card with the tracked link, in 9:16, 1:1 and 16:9.
seats.note: Host looks and voices are approved from a test reel first.

seats.label: Quality gate
seats.outcome: Claim check, captions match audio, loudness, duration, end card link resolves. A failed check stops that post and raises an alert.

seats.label: Publish
seats.outcome: Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and LinkedIn through the platform APIs, platform AI label set at upload, link carried as a tracked short link.
